title: aster lanceolatus
intro: Aster lanceolatus, commonly known as White Sagebrush, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is a shrubby perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of western North America, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aster lanceolatus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions, such as respiratory issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
